releaseNotes:
- Administrator accounts can now process up to ten video CG jobs concurrently while server-side queueing protects provider capacity
- Style Studio templates now show whether they append the shared generation contract or operate as template-only instructions
releaseNotesZh:
- 管理员账号现可并发处理最多十个视频 CG 任务，并由服务端排队机制保护供应商容量
- 风格工作室模板现会标明其是否追加通用生成约束，或仅使用模板自身指令
